description: In ed3 mode contention is jitter and every LBT wait is the one common value, lbt_wait_dcd_ms.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ (service type tx_mode 2, no confirmation) and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED with MTU 2048 (A-0041, A-0047). The S_UNIDATA_REQUEST is priority 0 to SAP 5 at 0.0.1.3, DELIVERY MODE default, TTL 0, U_PDU "hello"; it asks for no confirmation, so it produces no SIS output (A-0095), and it is data queued for transmission (K-0096). Ed3 settings per the K-0107 ruling: jitter contention, one common LBT value (lbt_wait_dcd_ms, here 20000), LBT rule 1 off. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15 then 4: 45000 ms then 12000 ms. lbt_wait_vdcd_ms is set to show it is not used; a VDCD-determined idle needs the receiver (P3-3).
